acceptance_results.evidence: Cross-project read/write refused, revoked membership closes the next request and an open stream with 4404, forged/over-claimed tokens refused, deactivation audited, no Owner DAG route. Independent review PASS; gate 147 tests.

Address policy refuses metadata/loopback/RFC1918/link-local/ULA/lying resolver/one-private-among-public; each redirect hop is guarded; the connection is pinned to the validated address; browser egress fails closed before Playwright. Independent review PASS.

Artifacts door: 65MiB chunked -> 413 with no store/rows/temp; 64MiB accepted below 16MiB peak. Lab door: request.stream -> temp file, configured limit, 413, unlink; repository no longer lists chunks: spools, hashes by re-read, passes file iterators; invalid filename 400 before body. Independent review PASS.
Real HTTP retrieval (example.com/Crossref/httpbin), explicit ACCESS_LIMITED/AUTH_REQUIRED/PAYWALLED/POLICY_BLOCKED without fabricated content; no mock evidence. Independent review PASS.

No HTTP admin deactivation route; repository/audit only.
DNS resolver trust: both lookups are validated and the connection pinned, but the resolver is an assumption.
